mentions.name: LLM KV cache eviction research
mentions.description: This project trains a model to predict how long each token should stay in a transformer's KV cache using only its key vectors, enabling selective cache eviction that can be added after the fact without retraining the core model.
mentions.problem: Most tokens in a sequence are irrelevant to attention outside a very small window, yet current approaches either keep all cache values forever or dump them all once they hit a certain age.
mentions.source_excerpt: Overly specific LLM research into KV cache eviction.
